Model: one lumped node per zone (oven.capacity, oven.wall_loss / mouth_loss, the band and product loads of oven.zone_loads), zone-to-zone air
exchange, TC lag. Assumed: ZONE_G, TC_TAU, the STB / limit temperatures - MEASURE (oven_ctrl.py header).
FB_Oven runs exactly this: feed-forward of the band content (learned W0 / a1) + PI + anti-windup + set-point ramp + heater-break check on the phase
